controls.title: Agent goal hijack
threats: Untrusted content changes the user goal or plan scope.
controls.residual_risk: Semantic extraction can be wrong even when authority does not propagate.

controls.title: Tool misuse and exploitation
threats: A plan selects an excessive or malformed tool action.
controls.residual_risk: A defect in a first-party tool can still create an unintended effect.

controls.title: Identity and privilege abuse
threats: Stale approval, mobile token, or credential reference is reused.
controls: high-impact mobile denial until PoP and biometric step-up
controls.residual_risk: A compromised same-user session can act with the user's local authority.

controls.title: Agentic supply-chain compromise
threats: A dependency, prompt, Skill, MCP server, or update is malicious or substituted.
controls.residual_risk: Signed third-party content may still be malicious.

controls.title: Unexpected code execution
threats: Generated or extension code runs with full user privileges.
controls.residual_risk: No claim of safe local execution is permitted before OS sandbox evidence.

controls.title: Memory and context poisoning
threats: Hostile external text is persisted and recalled as trusted guidance.
controls.residual_risk: User-approved memories may still contain inaccurate information.

controls.title: Insecure inter-agent communication
threats: Agent or tool messages lose provenance or carry hidden instructions.
controls.residual_risk: Legacy unwrapped message paths require incremental migration.

controls.title: Cascading failures
threats: Retries, fan-out, or repeated side effects amplify a failure.
controls.residual_risk: External systems may not expose idempotent or reversible APIs.

controls.title: Human-agent trust exploitation
threats: Misleading completion, approval fatigue, or hidden target changes cause unsafe consent.
controls.residual_risk: Users can still approve a clearly presented but incorrect business action.

controls.title: Rogue or compromised agents
threats: A model, connector, or extension intentionally exceeds its declared role.
controls.residual_risk: Unknown implementation defects require external testing and runtime monitoring.
